scores.tell: Hero large and tilted, fills the card like real cards. Truss crops at the top and right edges, a bit tight.
Wide scene with a small dome hero. It sits low and right with lots of moon ground around it. Real cards use one large hero.
Clock is centered and fills about 75% of the card with a small margin. It reads instantly, like the real cards.
Tilted rope fills the card with a loose loop. The negative space is a bit sparse and the loop nearly touches the right edge.
Plate of fruit is centered and large, but it is a cluster of several items with no single hero. The plate sits low.
Dock is a small hero in a big scene, with half the card empty water. The reflection and the foreground water compete for attention.
Bumper car fills the card and is cropped at the bottom and edges with the pole running off the top. Mostly good, but the floor is busy.
Crowded: target, bear, cans, ball and flag all compete. The marquee frame fills the card. There is no single hero.
Column is large and centered, filling the height. The yellow sign at the lower right competes slightly, and the pedestal is cropped at the bottom.
Pump is centered with good scale, but the wide desert scene and sunset add background. The base slab and sky leave extra space.
